pillars.label: Provision of targeted essential services and individual assistance
indicators: # of children benefiting from age, gender, disability sensitive mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) services

# of parents and caregivers participating in psychosocial support and/or positive parenting programmes to promote their mental health & psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to care for and support children.
# of PSS Kits distributed to child friendly spaces or families
# of adolescents (girls and boys) reached with life skills activities
# of children, caregivers with specific needs referred to services and assistance (Health, rehabilitation, MH, and MPCA, Shelter,  etc)
# of children identified at risk who receive case management services that meet their unique needs.
# of UASC (girls and boys) identified and documented though case management.
# of UASC (girls and boys) supported with family based and or community based alternative care arrangements
# of children reunified with their family and caregivers.
# of children at risk reached through distribution of weather-appropriate clothing kits
# of children who received C4P, or emergency case management funds (in cash) to prevent, mitigate, or respond to child protection risks
# of children with disabilities or injured by the conflict reached with assistive devices and/ or rehabilitation services
# of children and their caregivers who received legal assistance related to CP issues.
# of children and caregivers who received protection and social assistance in-kind and NFIs

pillars.label: Community-based protection and support to social cohesion
indicators: # of community-based child protection structures, or child/adolescent groups/clubs, established or supported (non – individual) to ensure community participation in child protection.
#  of members of community-based child protection structures trained on child protection approaches and referral mechanisms.
# of mobile teams established and functional this month (mobile groups)
# of CP safe space including child friendly spaces, and other safe spaces, child protection service points (centre) established and maintained for child well-being.

pillars.label: Communication and provision of information to reinforce people's capacities and strategies
indicators: # of children and caregivers benefiting from awareness-raising activities on key child protection risks, preventing and responding to family separation and life-saving information on CP service and risk mitigation measures
# of children and caregivers benefiting from EoRE risk education
# of children and caregivers aware of the ways to report safeguarding issues, including possible PSEA allegations

pillars.label: Capacity strengthening and institutional support to reinforce protection environment
indicators: # of frontline child protection workers (humanitarian staff) trained on child protection principles, approaches and standards and/or received staff care and well-being sessions.
# of CP partners staff (UN/INGOs/NGOs) trained on PSEA and child safeguarding
# of non-child protection humanitarian staff trained on CP approaches (including UASC), safe identification and referrals, child safeguarding, etc
